summary: Gray whales pass through the Bering Strait on one of the longest mammal migrations on Earth, between Arctic feeding grounds and Baja California lagoons.
seasonality: Transits northward in spring and southward in autumn.

summary: A small, critically endangered orca subpopulation hunts bluefin tuna in and around the Strait of Gibraltar.
conservationStatus: Critically Endangered (IUCN assessment of the Iberian subpopulation)
seasonality: Most often observed in the strait in summer, following tuna.

summary: Narwhals winter in the deep, ice-covered waters of Baffin Bay and Davis Strait, diving beneath the pack ice.
seasonality: Winters offshore in Baffin Bay–Davis Strait; summers in High Arctic fjords.

summary: The Torres Strait's seagrass meadows support one of the world's largest dugong populations, central to Torres Strait Islander culture.
Belugas move through Hudson Strait between the bay's summering estuaries and their Atlantic wintering grounds.
seasonality: Migrates through the strait in spring and autumn.

summary: Bluefin tuna funnel through the Strait of Gibraltar to spawn in the Mediterranean — a migration fished since Phoenician times and the prey that draws the strait's orcas.
seasonality: Enters the Mediterranean in late spring; returns to the Atlantic after spawning.

summary: One of the smallest cetaceans is a year-round resident of the Dover Strait's busy waters, sharing the world's densest shipping lane.
